text:
The Moon is 380000km from the Earth. A laser light beam is directed from the Earth to the
Moon. The beam is reflected back to the Earth.
How long does it take for the light to travel to the Moon and back to the Earth?
A
1.27ms
B
2.53ms
C
1.27s
D
2.53s
subject: Physics
